notIdeasOfWhatSocietyShouldBe.explanation: Miscellaneous right (divers droite) is a French official electoral category (nuance) for centre-right or right-wing candidates who belong to no large party, including small-party members, expelled dissidents and unaffiliated candidates; it is a classification of candidates, not a set of political positions. I went through the statements and the article names no position on any of them, and no critic attributes views to it, so fewer than two can be answered.
